Name: Talkohlooeys Seasonal Portraits for Childhood Sweetheart Caroline
Author: Oieshi
Description:
[b]First of all: [/b]This add-on does not contain explicit nudity or any adult content of that nature. However, I’ve placed it under that category because some outfits reveal a lot of skin.
Additionally, the [i]Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)[/i] mod includes a "Mature Events" configuration. (づ ᴗ _ᴗ)づ

[b]About This Mod:[/b] Talkohlooeys has created what I believe is one of the best portrait packs available. However, with so many mods to try, it’s common to find that non-vanilla content lacks portraits that match Talkohlooeys’ art style or blend well with existing ones. This is the case with the [i]Childhood Sweetheart Caroline[/i] mod.
While that mod features great portraits, they don’t fully match Talkohlooeys’ style. Because of this, I modified and created new portraits for Caroline so that she maintains the same artistic look while keeping the outfits and expressions from [i]Childhood Sweetheart Caroline[/i]. I also made her appear a bit younger since the mod portrays her as such—but I ensured she still looks like a MILF, rather than Abigail’s older sister!

folder inside. Copy this folder.

Next, find [i]1oxnes and Talkohlooeys’ Seasonal Portraits[/i] in your mods directory. Inside, locate the folder named [b][CP] 1oxnes and Talkohlooeys’ Seasonal Portraits[/b], then open the [b]assets[/b] folder.
Paste the [b][color=#ffff00]Portraits[/color][/b] folder you copied from my [color=#98f5f9]patch[/color] inside [b]assets[/b]. When prompted to replace existing files, select [b]Replace All[/b] to ensure Caroline’s portraits are updated throughout the seasonal folders.
That’s all! Your patch should now be active! [b]ദ്ദി ˉ͈̀꒳ˉ͈́ )✧
